clauses.src: The cat sits on the grass.
The puppy sits on the grass.
A small cartoon animal hides among tall green grass, peeking out.
It stays very still so no one can see it.
Many animals peek out carefully before moving.
The child runs happily outdoors alongside a small pet dog.
The dog wags its tail while running beside him.
Many children love playing outdoors with their pets.
On the sandy path, the happy young child runs quickly beside a small pet dog.
The tiger sits in the grass.
It is a big wild cat.
The child walks a dog on a leash outdoors.
He holds the leash firmly as they walk.
The small blue butterfly often opens its two spotted wings slowly.
The sun is in the sky.
It looks like a small tree.
The cake is on a plate.
It has a strawberry on top.
I eat a sandwich for lunch.
The chicken is on a plate.
I like to drink coconut water.
The child happily drinks a glass of milk.
Milk helps keep her bones strong.
A glass of milk gives the body important nutrients.
Beside the yellow curtain, the happy young child drinks a glass of milk slowly.
The child happily eats a piece of fruit.
He holds the fruit with both hands.
Fruit is a sweet and healthy snack.
It needs water and sunlight to grow well.
Many food plants start as small seedlings.
The juice tastes sweet and cold.
The stem is thin and short.
The peach tastes sweet and juicy.
The pear is juicy and crunchy.
I eat a pear after lunch.
The peas are in a bowl.
It has a spiky green top.
The steak is on a plate.
My friends go home by bus.
The child points with one finger at something off to the side.
He has a curious expression on his face.
Pointing helps show others where to look.
Children often point when something interests them.
A group of children sing together happily in a circle.
Their voices sound cheerful and bright.
The class sings a new song every week.
Two children sit together on a bench, chatting and smiling.
They enjoy spending time together after school.
Close friends often chat happily on a bench.
On the red bench, the two happy young children chat quietly near the green bushes.
He smiles while greeting his friend.
Children often wave when they feel happy.
The logs come from a tree.
The two big brown logs lie quietly on the soft green grass.
Children count to eighteen using the crayons.
Children count to eleven using the apples.
Children count to fifteen using the buttons.
Children count to fourteen using the stars.
Children count to nineteen using the ladybirds.
On the big green leaf, the nineteen small red ladybirds rest quietly near the white flowers.
Children count to seventeen using the marbles.
Children count to sixteen using the fish.
The crayons are in a row.
Children count to thirteen using the balloons.
Children count to twelve using the cupcakes.
Children count to twenty using the birds.
I carry my bag to school.
It has a star on it.
He keeps his books safe inside the bag.
A closed bag keeps everything from falling out.
A book is on the desk.
The chair is behind the desk.
The child draws lines and shapes on paper with a pencil.
He holds the pencil carefully while drawing.
Drawing is a fun and creative activity.
Art class helps pupils express their ideas.
The child mixes two paint colours together on a palette.
He watches a new colour appear as they blend.
Children love to experiment with different colours.
The child opens a big storybook on a school desk.
He looks at the pages with excitement.
Storybooks help children learn new words.
The child paints a picture at a small easel with a paintbrush.
He mixes different colours on his palette.
Art class is a favourite subject for many pupils.
One child hands a ruler to another child at a school desk.
He shares his ruler with a classmate.
Classmates often borrow rulers from each other.
The child sits properly at a school desk with hands folded.
She keeps her hands still on the desk.
In the bright classroom, the happy young child sits quietly at a wooden desk.
Two sides are longer than the others.
In the picture, the big green square always sits quietly on a white page.
The top of the triangle comes to a point.
I see a rocket on the screen.
The child cuts out paper shapes with round-tipped safety scissors.
She cuts carefully along the lines.
Safety scissors let young children cut without danger.
The doll has a pink dress.
The child runs outdoors happily flying a colourful kite.
The wind carries the kite high into the sky.
He holds the string tightly while running.
On the green grass, the happy young child runs quickly under two colourful kites.
It flies high in the sky.
They push the cars as fast as they can.
Racing toy cars is an exciting game.
Both children feel excited to see who wins.
The train goes round the track.
